_note: Compiled 2026-10-11 by houbař-výzkumník. WebFetch/curl to wikimedia.org were blocked in the sandbox (DNS/proxy), so every entry was confirmed only via web-search renderings of the Commons file pages: file exists, author, licence, place/date and species named in the description. Nobody has looked at the pixels yet, hence verified=false everywhere. fetch_photos.py re-reads the licence from Commons extmetadata on download and flags any mismatch.
